narration:0:1720953001:1.text: By the time you finish searching the whole manor, you're sure you've seen everything worth seeing...
narration:0:1720953001:1.male: By the time you finish searching the whole manor, you're sure you've seen everything worth seeing...
narration:0:1720953001:1.female: By the time you finish searching the whole manor, you're sure you've seen everything worth seeing...

say:2:1720953002:1.text: This is it! The proof's all here! Fake accounts, articles written before anything even happened, letters laying out the whole plot... If this comes to light, it'll shake the whole city!
say:2:1720953002:1.source_cn: 太棒了！罪证确凿！子爵的假账、未卜先知的报道、密谋的信...

say:4:1720953003:1.text: So we go back and write the story now, right? This is tomorrow's front page!
say:4:1720953003:1.source_cn: 老师，我们现在就回去写报道吗？明天《赛凡纳晨报》的头条...

say:5:1720953004:1.text: Not yet. The evidence is strong, but Demit is still a viscount, and he clearly has powerful people behind him. If we rush the story out now, the nobles will call it slander, and bury the whole thing before it has a chance to do any real damage.
say:5:1720953004:1.source_cn: 不……还不行。我有点担心，这些证据虽然劲爆，但德米特毕...

say:6:1720953005:1.text: At most, we'd make him look bad for a while. That's barely a slap on the wrist compared to what he's done. And if he manages to make a comeback later, there's a good chance he'll come after us!
say:6:1720953005:1.source_cn: 咱们的报道最多只能把他的名声搞臭，恐怕他不会受到什么实...

say:7:1720953006:1.text: So what do we do? We can't just stop here. We've already come this far! And as journalists, we're supposed to stand for the truth. We can't let fear of retaliation stop us... at least, that's how I see it.
say:7:1720953006:1.source_cn: 那我们该怎么办？都调查到这儿了，总不能放弃吧！作为记者...

say:9:1720953007:1.text: That would work, in theory. But would ordinary guards go near a case that touches the nobility?
say:9:1720953007:1.source_cn: 道理是这个道理，可是普通的守备军估计不敢插手这样的事吧……

choice_prompt:10:1720953008.text: Right. So who can actually make that happen?
choice_prompt:10:1720953008.source_cn: 道理是这个道理，可是该怎么做呢？

say:12:1720953010:1.text: With Commander Hendrik on this, we have nothing to worry about, right? Come on, let's get back and write the story. Savannah, get ready for a storm!

say:13:1720953011:1.text: Then that's the plan. Detective, you get the guard moving. We'll get the story ready to run. We can't let Viscount Demit wriggle his way out of this!
